messages:
andrea b: Heads-up — I opened a docs PR to reconcile quota panel labels with the pricing engine. The dashboard shows 'Tier 2' at 1k-10k but the billing spreadsheet rounds to 1k-9,999 which causes off-by-one in examples and the SDK snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4827 :eyes:

mike r: thanks. can you paste the exact sample that breaks? iirc the panel uses `>=1000 && <=10000` and our billing tiers are `>=1000 && <10000` so edge events at 10000 get double-counted in the docs examples.

andrea b: exact failing sample in the PR description — a snippet in "tiering.md":
```
# sample usage rows
user_id,requests
acct-123,999
acct-456,1000
acct-789,10000
```
when you run the calculator snippet it assigns acct-789 to tier 2 in the dashboard example but the pricing CSV maps it to tier 3.

cheng li: we should standardize on half-open intervals in docs: [min, max) everywhere. that matches the metering pipeline we ship. i can add a one-line note and update the panel docs.

sam_k: agree with half-open intervals. also the SDK v6 header example in the metering snippet uses `X-Redwood-Quota: 1000` but doesn't show units. suggest: `X-Redwood-Quota: 1000 (requests)` in the comment and a tiny JS example.

mike r: small nit — some customers rely on the human-readable dashboard labels "1k-10k". if we change text to "1k-9,999" it looks worse. propose keep rounded labels for UX but call out the exact interval semantics in a tooltip example and in the examples folder.

marie: +1 to preserving UI labels. i can add a tooltip note for the Grafana panel and update the docs code sample to call out the [min, max) rule. i'll also add a one-liner about rounding semantics in FAQ.

andrea b: great. action items: 1) cheng update `tiering.md` to state half-open intervals (PR patch ready), 2) sam add the clarified SDK snippet (JS + curl) to `snippets/metering`, 3) marie add tooltip text and FAQ entry, 4) mike you ok to keep UI labels but add parenthetical precise intervals?

mike r: yes i can do that — i'll file a small panel-annotation PR.

cheng li: pushing changes in a sec. note: changed wording to "Intervals are half-open: [min, max) — max belongs to the next tier." also adjusted example calculations.

sam_k: added SDK examples (JS & curl) in my commit — snippet uses explicit units in comment and shows header + body: ```js
// JS example
await client.request('/usage/calc', { headers: { 'X-Redwood-Quota': '1000 (requests)' }, body: { user_id: 'acct-789', requests: 10000 } });
```

marie: PR for tooltip landed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4831 — tooltip text: "Dashboard labels are rounded for readability. Actual quota intervals are half-open: [min, max)."

andrea b: awesome. last thing — localization team flagged that the link to the billing CSV in the migration guide pointed to a private internal sheet. i replaced it with the canonical public export link in the PR but can someone sanity-check? the link is: https://docs.redwood.ai/public/billing-tiers.csv

mike r: checked link, looks good. small suggestion: add a checksum/hash in the docs so users know if they downloaded the right file. i can add that in my panel PR.

cheng li: quick test run on sample rows — all now map consistently to the same tiers in both the dashboard example and the SDK sample. no regressions.

andrea b: thanks team. i've left a short checklist in the PR: update examples, add tooltip, update SDK snippet, switch CSV link, call out half-open intervals. i'll merge once all small PRs are green and l10n signoff is done. :thumbsup:
